checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phone topbar wrap, no-horizontal-scroll measurement, cache v8 and mobile played run verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle4-mobile-hud' completed successfully.
[1/3] Keep SURGE 1.5x visible for the whole board with a persistent stage badge

impact_assessment.why: SURGE context is announced only in the status line; any wrong pick replaces it with 'Not that one', leaving no visible sign that the board still pays 1.5x
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can see the bonus for the entire board, including after mistakes; level presentation matches the score opportunity
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one decorative DOM node inside the stage, aria-hidden; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (visibility tied to def.surge)
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing shell/CSS/JS contract test first; same-state before/after screenshots with a wrong pick on Daily board 4; scripted playthrough across surge and normal boards; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Persistent SURGE stage badge, show/hide paths, cache v9 and a full Daily run verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle5-surge-badge' completed successfully.
[1/3] Sanitize the persisted daily record so a malformed result cannot break boot or daily deep links

impact_assessment.why: A saved daily result with a valid date but no score throws in renderDaily at boot; the Daily deep link then stays on the menu and never starts, confirmed with a TypeError
impact_assessment.benefits: Corrupt or partially migrated daily saves render safely, the menu keeps working, and daily deep links always start; malformed values are dropped instead of crashing
impact_assessment.risks: contract: afterimage.daily.result shape unchanged for valid saves, invalid results become null; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: only the loader normalizes/clamps values
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first sanitizer and loader tests; same corrupt-save deep-link screenshot pair; full 10-board recovery run with zero console errors; all gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Daily result sanitizer and loader validation, corrupt-save deep link, full recovery run and cache v10 verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle6-corrupt-daily' completed successfully.
[1/3] Reveal the odd tile briefly on the fatal miss before the result screen

impact_assessment.why: A wrong pick that ends the run goes straight to the result after 640ms; the player never learns which tile was odd, unlike the timeout path which reveals it for 1150ms
impact_assessment.benefits: Every failed run teaches the answer; fatal misses and timeouts give the same fair reveal; the result no longer feels arbitrary
impact_assessment.risks: contract: only the fatal timed-miss path extends from 640ms to 1150ms and sets reveal; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: reuses existing state.reveal overlay
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure shouldRevealMiss test first; deterministic Daily three-miss screenshot pair at the fatal moment; played run logs reveal, status, result and board strip; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Fatal-miss reveal, 1150ms beat, cache v11 and a three-miss Daily run verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle7-fatal-reveal' completed successfully.
[1/3] Give timeouts, wins and losses their own audible cues instead of reusing the wrong-pick buzz

impact_assessment.why: A timeout plays the same single 146Hz tone as a wrong pick, and the result screen is silent, so the three outcomes are indistinguishable by ear
impact_assessment.benefits: Timeout, win and loss each have a distinct, recognisable contour; players can hear the outcome even before reading the result
impact_assessment.risks: contract: WebAudio-only additions, muted storage respected; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persisted changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure-ish oscillator-capture test with a fake AudioContext; before/after tone logs from a real Chromium run; full suite and gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Distinct timeout/win/loss cues, oscillator capture, real-Chromium tone logs, cache v12 and played Daily/Zen runs verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle8-audio-cues' completed successfully.
[1/3] Remove the duplicated Zen practice pointer from the warming-up debrief

impact_assessment.why: A failed run's result says Zen is a good place to study the boards and then immediately says the weakest type costs most - Zen is a good place to study them, repeating the same advice twice
impact_assessment.benefits: The debrief reads as one clear diagnosis plus one specific practice pointer instead of duplicated filler
impact_assessment.risks: contract: copy-only change to the WARMING UP rating blurb; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first rateRun test; same three-miss Daily result screenshot pair; full suite and gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] WARMING UP debrief de-duplicated, copy test, same-state screenshots, cache v13 and gates verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle9-debrief-copy' completed successfully.
[1/3] Mark the final board as the run's boss with a persistent FINAL BOARD badge and stage glow

impact_assessment.why: The last board looks identical to every other board; its only cue is a transient status line, so the run's climax has no persistent visual identity
impact_assessment.benefits: The final board reads as a deliberate boss beat, the stage glow frames the climax, and the marker clears for results/menu
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one aria-hidden badge + a stage class, no scoring or script changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persisted data
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure isFinalBoard test and shell/CSS contract first; same daily board 10 before/after stage captures; 10-board played run checks badge only on the final board and result hides it; full gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Final-board badge and finale glow, pure boundary test, shell contract, cache v14 and a 10-board played run verified (checklists: passed)
Task 'afterimage-cycle10-final-boss' completed successfully.
